description: This file defines the 'ConceptComplex' class, a subclass of 'Concept' in the OpenMRS core, which adds handling for complex observations through a specific handler. It includes constructors, overrides, and accessor methods related to complex concept handling.

classes.name: ConceptComplex
classes.description: A subclass of Concept that associates a complex observation handler with the Concept, indicating it handles complex data types.

methods.name: ConceptComplex()
methods.description: Default constructor for the ConceptComplex class.

methods.name: ConceptComplex(Integer conceptId)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a ConceptComplex with a given concept ID.

methods.name: ConceptComplex(Integer conceptId, String handler)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a ConceptComplex with a given concept ID and a handler string.

methods.name: ConceptComplex(Concept c)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a ConceptComplex from an existing Concept object, copying its properties.

methods.name: isComplex()
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to indicate whether this concept is of complex datatype (returns true if datatype's HL7 abbreviation is "ED").

methods.name: setHandler(String handler)
methods.description: Sets the handler key associated with this complex concept.

methods.name: getHandler()
methods.description: Returns the handler key associated with this complex concept.
